Interesting! After SPACE with the stamp at the block area:
- g (gray) px=30
- p (purple) px=84
- p (purple) px=75
- W (white) px=25

So the stamp position matters! When I stamp with the stamp at the block area, it stamps the block at that position. This is different from stamping with the stamp at the top (which stamps the entire block).
Let me explore this further. The stamp seems to be a local operator that modifies the block at the stamp's current position.
Let me try moving the stamp around the block and stamping at different positions to see what happens.

Let me try moving the stamp UP to return it to the top, and then try stamping again to see if the behavior is different.
Actually, let me first try moving the stamp around the block to see if I can create the white-over-purple pattern by stamping at different positions.
